summary: Verified bug fix for transparent popup backgrounds in live scoring. Per-player Shot dropdown Goal button now correctly opens team shot modal (with solid white bg) pre-configured with player and goal type, instead of the broken showAssistPicker state. All modals have solid opaque backgrounds.

Team shot modal at line 1905 has proper bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl styling
On-field picker modal at line 1836 has proper bg-white rounded-xl styling
Per-player shot dropdown at line 2683 has bg-white background

per_player_shot_dropdown_goal_button.details: Clicking Goal from per-player Shot dropdown opens team shot modal (setShowTeamShotModal) with player pre-selected (playerId: player.id) and shot type set to 'goal' (shotType: 'goal'). No longer triggers broken showAssistPicker state.

team_shot_modal_white_background.details: Team shot modal has solid white background with class 'bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl max-w-sm w-full overflow-hidden'. No transparency issues.

assist_picker_in_team_shot_modal.details: When GOAL is selected in team shot modal, assist picker dropdown appears allowing selection of assist player or 'No Assist'.

goal_submission_triggers_on_field_picker.details: Clicking GOAL! button in team shot modal triggers on-field picker modal with 'Players On Field At Goal' title. Score updates correctly (Eagles 0->1).

on_field_picker_white_background.details: On-field picker modal has solid white background with class 'bg-white rounded-xl'. Shows both teams (Scored/Scored On) with player checkboxes.

team_shot_button_modal_white_background.details: Team SHOT buttons (blue for Eagles, red for Hawks) open team shot modal with same solid white background styling.

shot_dropdown_menu_white_background.details: Per-player Shot dropdown menu has white background (bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg shadow-xl) containing Goal/Save/Miss options.
